Mounjaro® (tirzepatide)

Once-weekly Mounjaro, along with diet and exercise, helps improve blood sugar in people with type 2 diabetes (T2D) aged 10+ and reduces the risk of major cardiovascular (CV) events (heart attack, stroke, or CV death) in adults with T2D at high risk for these events. Not for use in children under 10.

How to get started with Mounjaro

Mounjaro is available for self-pay through LillyDirect. Start by talking to your doctor to see if Mounjaro is right for you, then follow the steps below.

Step 1

Ask your doctor to send your prescription to:

LillyDirect Pharmacy
NPI: 1912889320 | NCPDP: 1574056
1555 S Harding St, Ste 171-B68,  Indianapolis, IN 46221

If you need help finding a doctor, we can connect you with virtual and in-person care.

Step 2

Once your prescription is received, a pharmacy partner will reach out to guide you through the next steps. They’ll help confirm details, explore any available savings, choose pharmacy options, and let you know when your medicine is ready for checkout.
